title: Incisional hernia prediction using machine learning models.
summary: Retrospective midline-laparotomy model predicts 24-month incisional hernia with imaging confirmation; cross-validation is internal and does not establish external transportability.
ai_technology: XGBoost models predict 24-month incisional hernia after midline laparotomy using selected patient and clinical features.
